items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Hi! Your resume was selected for a Remote Data Entry Associate role at Amazon ($42/hr). Interviews are conducted on Telegram - add [handle]. Once hired, purchase your home-office kit ($450) through our approved vendor and you'll be reimbursed with your first check. Please respond within 2 hours to keep your spot.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Earn $300 a day from home! Complete 40 simple tasks rating hotels to unlock your commission. New members must top up their account with USDT to start the next set of tasks.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Congratulations, you have been hired as an Administrative Assistant. We will mail you a check for $2,800. Deposit the check using mobile deposit, keep $400 as your first week pay and send the remaining balance to our equipment supplier via Zelle.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: We are hiring a Package Inspector to work from home. You will receive parcels at your address, check them and reship them using the prepaid labels we email you. $2,500 per month, no experience needed.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Hello, I am a recruiter for Google. You have been selected for a remote typing job, $38/hr, flexible hours. Interviews are done on Telegram. Please send a copy of your driver's license to proceed.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Hi, this is Lisa from the HR team. Part-time online job, earn $500 a day by liking videos for commission. Add me on WhatsApp to begin. Limited positions available.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Good news! You are selected for the Customer Support position at Walmart. To process payroll please reply with your SSN, bank account number and routing number today.

items.label: LIKELY_SCAM
items.text: Hello, I am looking for a personal assistant to help with errands. First task: buy three $100 Apple gift cards and send me photos of the back of the cards. You will be paid $800 per week.
